# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 3 tokens; Text — 3 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 5 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 5 tokens; Radius — 3 tokens; Shadow — 1 token.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--ground, #0f0d0b);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #0f0d0b;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--ground` | #0f0d0b | Fond de page, comme une salle de cinéma éteinte. |
| `--surface` | #1a1612 | Cartes de film, listes de critiques, barres de navigation. |
| `--surface-raised` | #262019 | Survol, menus, champs de saisie, bloc de pellicule sur la couverture. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--ink, #f5ecdf);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #f5ecdf;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #f5ecdf | Texte principal sur ground, surface et surface-raised (≥14:1). |
| `--ink-muted` | #b3a493 | Métadonnées (année, durée, réalisateur, date) et notes basses (≤ 2/5). 7:1 sur surface. |
| `--ink-on-amber` | #1a1206 | Texte et icônes sur amber, amber-soft et orange (≥7:1). |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--line, #3a3128);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #3a3128;
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--line` | #3a3128 | Filets de séparation et bordures de cartes (1px). |
| `--amber` | #ffb627 | Couleur de marque. Étoiles de notation, bouton principal, onglet actif. Texte en ink-on-amber dessus. |
| `--amber-soft` | #ffd98a | Notes partielles (demi-étoile), surbrillance de citation, puces de genre au survol. |
| `--orange` | #ff7a1a | Accent : liens, badge « Coup de cœur », focus ring, et messages d'erreur (toujours avec une icône et un texte). 3:1+ sur tous les fonds. |
| `--ember` | #c2410c | Grands aplats décoratifs et fond de bandeaux uniquement. 3.5:1 sur ground : jamais pour du texte courant. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 400 64px/60px "Bebas Neue", Impact, "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.5px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display); letter-spacing: 0.5px;
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `.display`, `--text-display` | 64px / 60px, letter-spacing 0.5px | 400 | `display` | Titre de film en héros, page d'accueil. |
| `h1` | `.h1`, `--text-h1` | 40px / 40px, letter-spacing 0.5px | 400 | `display` | Titre de page. |
| `h2` | `.h2`, `--text-h2` | 28px / 30px, letter-spacing 0.5px | 400 | `display` | Titre de section. |
| `score` | `.score`, `--text-score` | 36px / 36px | 400 | `display` | Note chiffrée d'un film, en amber. |
| `title` | `.title`, `--text-title` | 18px / 24px | 600 | `sans` | Titre de film dans une carte. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 15px / 23px | 400 | `sans` | Corps des critiques. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 13px / 16px, letter-spacing 0.6px | 600 | `sans` | Genres, onglets, boutons (en capitales). |
| `caption` | `.caption`, `--text-caption` | 12px / 16px | 400 | `sans` | Métadonnées en ink-muted. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `--font-display` | `"Bebas Neue", Impact, "Arial Narrow", sans-serif` |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Écart entre étoiles, entre icône et libellé. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Espacement interne des puces et badges. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Marge interne des cartes, gouttière de la grille d'affiches. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Écart entre sections, marges de page mobile. |
| `--space-10` | 40px | Grandes respirations : héros, en-têtes de page. |


| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--radius-sm` | 4px | Affiches de film, perforations, badges. |
| `--radius-md` | 10px | Cartes, champs, boutons. |

## Shadow

Pas d'ombre portée : seulement la lueur du projecteur.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--glow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,182,39,0.45), 0 8px 32px rgba(255,182,39,0.28)) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--glow), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--glow` | 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,182,39,0.45), 0 8px 32px rgba(255,182,39,0.28) | Survol du bouton principal et des affiches : la lumière de l'écran. |
